subject: Discrepancy in the Section 26 05 33 conduit routing between One-Line Diagram E-002 and

messages.text: Coordination review turned up a mismatch on the Section 26 05 33 conduit routing between Electrical Detail 2/E502 and One-Line Diagram E-002 -- can you confirm which is correct before we release for fabrication? This is routine and can be worked into the normal submittal cycle. No cost impact is anticipated. This could affect the electrical rough-in schedule. Please respond before the panel energization walkthrough. We don't have a fixed turnaround in mind for this -- it depends on the BIM detailer's next clash pass, which isn't on a set schedule.
